nodes.label: AuroreMkVII Real-Time Turret Defense System
nodes.rationale: C++17 real-time vision-based fire control system for Raspberry Pi 5, 1536×864 @ 120Hz, WCET ≤5ms budget

nodes.label: 7-State Fire Control System State Machine
nodes.rationale: FSM manages 7 operational modes: BOOT→IDLE_SAFE→{FREECAM,SEARCH}→TRACKING→ARMED with FAULT entry from any state. Implements AM7-L1-MODE-002 and AM7-L3-MODE-001 requirements.

nodes.label: Vision Pipeline (libcamera RAW10→BGR888)
nodes.rationale: Low-latency image acquisition and processing: Sony IMX708 CSI-2 acquisition, zero-copy DMA buffering via LockFreeRingBuffer<ZeroCopyFrame>, BGR demosaic in wrap_as_mat()

nodes.label: 4-Thread SCHED_FIFO Real-Time Model
nodes.rationale: Pin-isolated CPU execution: safety_monitor (P99, CPU3, 1kHz) → actuation_output (P95, CPU2, 120Hz) → vision_pipeline (P90, CPU2, 120Hz) → track_compute (P85, CPU2, 120Hz) with phase staggering to prevent cache contention

nodes.label: Safety Monitor 1kHz Watchdog
nodes.rationale: Real-time deadline enforcement across all threads via SafetyMonitor class. Detects vision stalls, actuation deadline misses, temperature anomalies, and autonomous transitions to FAULT state on timeout.

nodes.label: Fusion HAT+ 12-Channel Gimbal Controller
nodes.rationale: 50Hz servo control via sysfs PWM interface. Drives azimuth/elevation gimbal with software endstops (-90°/90° az, -10°/+45° el) and rate limiting (60°/s velocity, 120°/s² acceleration).

nodes.label: Asynchronous Telemetry Writer (CSV+JSON Logging)
nodes.rationale: Non-blocking per-frame logging of vision, tracking, actuation, and health data. Backpressure-safe queue with drop policies (kDropOldest, kDropNewest, kBlock) prevents RT thread blocking. AM7-L2-HUD-001 compliance.

nodes.label: WCET Budget: ≤5ms per Vision Frame
nodes.rationale: Hard real-time constraint: vision pipeline + tracking computation must complete within 5ms to maintain 120Hz @ 8.333ms period. Measured max 3.03ms (P100 SCHED_OTHER) on RPi5.

nodes.label: Zero-Copy DMA Invariant (No Memcpy on RT Path)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-VIS-001 enforcement: camera DMA buffers are used directly via cv::Mat header wrapping. ISP produces BGR888 (B,G,R byte order); wrap_as_mat returns zero-copy header with stride info, eliminating spurious cvtColor copy.
nodes.norm_label: zero-copy dma invariant (no memcpy on rt path)

nodes.label: LockFreeRingBuffer<T, N> SPSC Lock-Free Buffer
nodes.rationale: Cache-aligned power-of-2 lock-free queue for zero-copy frame transfer between producer (vision) and consumer (tracking). Capacity = N-1; holds at most 3 pending frames in 4-entry buffer.

nodes.label: Hardware Testing Policy: No Mocks, Fail-Fast
nodes.rationale: Absolute rule: hardware tests use REAL hardware only; graceful degradation prohibited. Tests must detect missing hardware within 500ms and fail with clear connection instructions. No skip messages; PASS or FAIL only.
nodes.norm_label: hardware testing policy: no mocks, fail-fast

nodes.label: 10-Part Robustness Test Suite + 5-Tier CI
nodes.rationale: Pure-logic test families: memory stability, state integrity, fault containment, concurrency pathology, temporal consistency, numeric robustness, hostile input, resource exhaustion, reset recovery, observability. Tiers 0-4 with CTest label filtering.

nodes.label: TestInfrastructure: Instrumentation Without Mocks
nodes.rationale: Thin wrappers (LogTester, OffsetTracker, FaultTimeline, CrashDumpTester) that instrument production subsystem calls without simulated behavior. Enables parameterized test execution against real SafetyMonitor, StateMachine, LockFreeRingBuffer SUTs.

nodes.label: AM7 Requirements Traceability (AM7-L1/L2/L3-*)
nodes.rationale: 3-level requirement taxonomy: L1 (System-level), L2 (Interface/behavior), L3 (Detailed implementation). Tags like AM7-L3-VIS-001 (zero-copy), AM7-L3-MODE-001 (transition matrix), AM7-L2-SEC-001 (HMAC) provide unique requirement identifiers.

nodes.label: Fault Code Enumeration (8 Distinct Faults)
nodes.rationale: FaultCode enum: CAMERA_TIMEOUT (0), GIMBAL_TIMEOUT (1), RANGE_DATA_STALE (2), RANGE_DATA_INVALID (3), AUTH_FAILURE (4), SEQUENCE_GAP (5), TEMPERATURE_CRITICAL (6), WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT (7). Any fault triggers FAULT state entry.

nodes.label: Gimbal Constraints in Read-Only Data
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-ACT-001: Gimbal mechanical limits stored in .rodata (not mutable at runtime): Elevation -10° to +45°, Azimuth ±90°, velocity ≤60°/s, acceleration ≤120°/s². Prevents runtime modification attacks.

nodes.label: HMAC Authentication + Firmware Signing (ECDSA)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L2-SEC-001: Command message integrity via HMAC. AM7-L2-SEC-002: Firmware updates signed with ECDSA. AM7-L2-SEC-004: Replay attack prevention via sequence numbers. AM7-L2-SEC-003: Audit log HMAC.

nodes.label: Dual-Camera Pipeline: MIPI CSI-2 + USB Fallback
nodes.rationale: Primary: IMX708 CSI-2 (libcamera, rp1-cfe driver, /dev/video0-7). Optional USB camera fallback for integration tests. OpticalGate detects/reconciles MIPI vs USB stream misalignment.
nodes.norm_label: dual-camera pipeline: mipi csi-2 + usb fallback

nodes.label: KCF (Kernelized Correlation Filter) Tracker Selection
nodes.rationale: KCF chosen over CSRT: 1-2ms execution @ 1536×864 (within 5ms budget) vs CSRT 10-20ms. Trade-off: no scale-change detection (acceptable for fixed-range targets). 1-frame latency acceptable.

nodes.label: ORB (Oriented FAST + BRIEF) Feature Detector
nodes.rationale: Initial target acquisition via feature-based detection. ORB provides keypoint candidates which are validated before KCF tracker initialization. Replaces YOLO inference for fast acquire.

nodes.label: Ballistic Solver with Precomputed p_hit Lookup Tables
nodes.rationale: Trajectory computation for lead calculation and hit probability. Precomputed LUT avoids runtime float divisions. Returns nullopt on NaN/Inf/negative/zero range (AM7-L3-SAFE-002).
nodes.norm_label: ballistic solver with precomputed p_hit lookup tables

nodes.label: M01 50m Laser Rangefinder on UART
nodes.rationale: External distance sensor on /dev/ttyAMA0. UART driver handles CRC validation, frame parsing. Range bounds [0.5m, 5000m] per hardware constraints. Typically measures ~0.24m at short range.

nodes.label: Control Loop Frequency: 120Hz @ 8.333ms Period
nodes.rationale: All vision/tracking/actuation tasks synchronized to 120Hz period. Phase staggering: vision at T=0ms, track at T=2ms, actuation at T=4ms within same 8.333ms frame window.

nodes.label: Hardware Interlock Safety Isolation (GPIO)
nodes.rationale: GPIO-based mechanical interlock controller. Prevents effector discharge if gimbal position unsafe or watchdog timeout. Dual-channel redundancy per AM7-L3-MODE-007 FAULT state safety enforcement.

nodes.label: MJPEG Streaming + HUD Socket (Unix Domain)
nodes.rationale: Real-time HTTP MJPEG streamer on TCP port 8080 for remote viewing. Separate HUD socket (UNIX domain) for telemetry: reticle, range, state, target bbox @ 120Hz. AM7-L2-HUD-002 compliance.

nodes.label: Aurore-Link Command Protocol (TCP Encrypted)
nodes.rationale: Network command interface: state request, gimbal control, target designation. HMAC authentication, sequence number tracking, 500ms heartbeat timeout triggers EMERGENCY_INHIBIT.

nodes.label: Config Loader (JSON Format)
nodes.rationale: config/config.json provides runtime configuration: camera params, gimbal limits, watchdog thresholds, network endpoints. Graceful degradation on parse error (use built-in defaults).

nodes.label: RPi5 CPU Isolation + RT Kernel (isolcpus, nohz_full, rcu_nocbs)
nodes.rationale: Target platform: Raspberry Pi 5 ARM64. Kernel cmdline isolation: isolcpus=2-3 nohz_full=2-3 rcu_nocbs=2-3 irqaffinity=0-1. CPU governor set to 'performance'. SCHED_FIFO + mlockall required for RT guarantee.
nodes.norm_label: rpi5 cpu isolation + rt kernel (isolcpus, nohz_full, rcu_nocbs)

nodes.label: MISRA C++:2023 Code Compliance
nodes.rationale: All new code targets MISRA C++:2023 or MISRA C++:2008. Rules enforced: 0-1-1 (no unreachable), 5-0-* (no implicit conversion), 6-4-* (no dynamic alloc after init), 18-4-1 (no heap in RT). clang-tidy enabled.

nodes.label: Exception Handling Strategy (Catch Blocks, No Abort)
nodes.rationale: Removed 11 std::abort() calls; replaced with proper exception handling and fault logging. 13 catch blocks handle CameraException, cv::Exception, Ort::Exception, JSON parse errors, allowing graceful degradation or FAULT state entry.
nodes.norm_label: exception handling strategy (catch blocks, no abort)

nodes.label: Session-Based Maintenance & Audit Rounds (2026-03-*)
nodes.rationale: Iterative spec conformance audits: ses_3239 (init phase), ses_3240 (safety + actuation), ses_3241 (firmware signing), ses_3243 (integration). Each documents gap closure, test additions, commit SHAs.

nodes.label: Issue Report: ~270 Potential Error Paths
nodes.rationale: Catalog of stderr warnings, errno checks, unhandled exceptions, socket errors, hardware timeouts across codebase. Status (2026-04-27): 91 fixed (34%), 237+ tests pass. All critical/high items resolved.

nodes.label: Jitter Analysis: P99.9 ≤ 417µs Timing Test
nodes.rationale: AM7-L2-TIM-003 requirement: 10k-sample jitter distribution test. Measured on RPi5 SCHED_FIFO threads. P99.9 ≤ 417µs validates timing stability for 120Hz control loop.

nodes.label: Target Lock Confirmation (Δ≤5px Position Delta)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-TGT-002: Lock valid when predicted vs measured centroid delta ≤ 5 pixels. Prevents ghost tracks and false positives. PSR threshold ≥ 0.035 for KCF confidence.

nodes.label: Target De-selection (30-Frame Low-PSR Counter)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-TGT-003: If PSR drops below threshold for 30 consecutive frames (~250ms @ 120Hz), tracker loses lock and reverts to SEARCH state.

nodes.label: Operator Authorization Gate for ARMED State (100ms Timeout)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-MODE-010: Entering ARMED requires operator explicit authorization. If withdrawn, ARMED → IDLE_SAFE within 100ms. Five simultaneous conditions: redetection ≥95%, stable timing, zero faults, authorization, p_hit≥95%.
nodes.norm_label: operator authorization gate for armed state (100ms timeout)

nodes.label: Command Rate Limiting (120 msg/sec Token Bucket)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-IF-003: HudSocket enforces 120 message/sec limit via token bucket. Excess commands are queued; overflow counter logged. Prevents network-based DoS attacks.
nodes.norm_label: command rate limiting (120 msg/sec token bucket)

nodes.label: State-Command Matrix Test (50 Assertions, 7×Commands)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-IF-004: Unit test validates which commands are valid in each state. 7 states × available commands = 50+ assertions ensuring spec compliance.

nodes.label: Gimbal Sequence Gap Detection (Freecam Callback Wired)
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-ACT-002: Detects command sequence gaps in gimbal control. Freecam callback wired to detect transitions; triggers fault if gap > 1000.
nodes.norm_label: gimbal sequence gap detection (freecam callback wired)

nodes.label: Firmware Update: Dual-Bank A/B with ECDSA Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: AM7-L3-SEC-005: Firmware OTA support. Dual-bank A/B allows atomic swap. ECDSA signature check before activation. Version number validation prevents downgrade attacks.
nodes.norm_label: firmware update: dual-bank a/b with ecdsa signature verification

nodes.label: Build Toolchain: build-release.sh, build-debug.sh, build-native.sh
nodes.rationale: Primary: ./scripts/build-release.sh → build-release/ (aarch64 RPi5). Debug: ./scripts/build-debug.sh. Native (host): ./scripts/build-native.sh. All CMake-based with clang-tidy, clang-format targets.
